title: 第一卷 第13章 二少放心，我不会让你负责的
content_zh:
车厢里的气氛，静得有些诡异。

    童喻深呼吸，刚才他这一脚刹车真的是毫无防备。

    寂静的空间里，流淌着彼此的呼吸声。

    窗外疾驰而过的车，还有不明所以被挡了路，带着催促和愤怒的鸣笛声，隐隐落入耳朵里，又从耳边擦过。

    童喻不喜欢这种压抑的气氛。

    她看向霍放，“二少放心，我不会让你负责的。”

    霍放重新踩下油门，“我是受害人。”

    “……”童喻就多余说这么一句。

    她忘记他之前说过，是他吃了哑巴亏。

    这男人，风流的名声在外，在她这里反而成了一个纯情小处男了。

    “你家在哪里？”霍放重新问了一遍。

    童喻这会儿没有之前那么紧张了。

    “我不想带男人回家里。”童喻话也是说得够直白。

    “……”

    霍放没再问她，车子开了几分钟后，到了闹市，他把车停在了公交站台，“下车。”

    童喻诧异地望着他。

    “我今晚没兴趣。”霍放没看她，语气冷淡。

    童喻心中一喜，她面上一副失落的模样，“那我走了。”

    她伸手从后排座拿上包包，推开车门，下车后把车门轻轻关上，站在一旁，目送着他离开。

    看不到车尾灯后，童喻才狠狠地松了一口气，脸上的笑容也不由得散开。

    她没有回家，打车回了【云上】。

    该挣的钱，她一分也不能少挣了。

    。

    四月的凌晨两点，还是有些冷。

    童喻拿上外套走出夜场大门，天雾蒙蒙的，地上湿滑。

    冯姿骑着小电驴停在童喻面前，笑着说：“公主，请上车。”

    童喻笑了。

    接过冯姿递过来的安全帽子戴上，“你怎么来了？”

    “我帮别人顶班。知道你这个点下班，就顺道过来接你去吃点东西，再回家睡觉，多香。”

    童喻坐在冯姿身后，轻轻搂着她的腰，“走吧，小姿姿。”

    宋源走出来正好看到童喻坐着冯姿的小电驴离开。

    身边的人好奇，“昨晚童喻是跟着霍二少走的，又跑回来上班不说，怎么还是个女人骑小电车来接她下班的呢？”
content_en:
The atmosphere in the carriage was eerily quiet.

    Tong Yu took a deep breath. He was really unprepared when he braked just now.

    In the silent space, the sounds of each other's breathing flowed.

    Cars were speeding by outside the window, some were blocked for unknown reasons, and their horns sounded urging and angry, faintly falling into their ears and then passing by.

    Tong Yu didn't like this depressing atmosphere.

    She looked at Huo Fang and said, "Don't worry, Second Young Master, I won't let you take responsibility."

    Huo Fang stepped on the accelerator again, "I am the victim."

    "..." Tong Yu said nothing more.

    She forgot that he had said before that it was him who suffered the loss of being mute.

    This man, who had a reputation for being romantic, turned out to be an innocent little virgin to her.

    "Where is your home?" Huo Fang asked again.

    Tong Yu was not as nervous as before.

    "I don't want to bring a man home." Tong Yu said it bluntly.

    "..."

    Huo Fang didn't ask her again. After the car drove for a few minutes, he arrived at the downtown area. He parked the car at the bus stop and said, "Get off."

    Tong Yu looked at him in surprise.

    "I'm not interested tonight." Huo Fang said coldly without looking at her.

    Tong Yu felt happy, but she looked disappointed, "Then I'm leaving."

    She reached for her bag from the back seat, pushed open the car door, got out of the car, closed the door gently, and stood aside, watching him leave.

    After the taillights were no longer visible, Tong Yu breathed a sigh of relief, and the smile on his face couldn't help but spread.

    She didn't go home and took a taxi back to [Yunshang].

    She couldn't earn any less of the money she should earn.

    .

    It's two o'clock in the morning in April and it's still a bit cold.

    Tong Yu took his coat and walked out of the nightclub. The sky was foggy and the ground was slippery.

    Feng Zi rode a small electric donkey and stopped in front of Tong Yu, smiling and saying: "Princess, please get on the bus."

    Tong Yu smiled.

    He took the safety hat handed over by Feng Zi and put it on, "Why are you here?"

    "I'm helping someone else work. I knew you were off work at this time, so I stopped by to pick you up and have something to eat before going home to sleep. How delicious."

    Tong Yu sat behind Feng Zi and gently hugged her waist, "Let's go, little Zizi."

    Song Yuan walked out just in time to see Tong Yu leaving on Feng Zi's little electric donkey.

    People around her were curious, "Tong Yu followed Mr. Huo last night and ran back to work. How could a woman ride a tram to pick her up from get off work?"
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 13 Don’t worry, Second Young Master, I won’t let you take responsibility.
